Frequently Asked Questions

When will I get my results? + −

Scores are released usually within 6 days after the test. You will be able to download a PDF copy of your results in 8 days after the test. You may choose to receive a paper score report during registration. Delivery times vary based on your location.

What do I carry for the exam? + −

Just two things. 1) Your passport, and 2) Registration Confirmation email. Mobile devices or other personal items are not allowed in the testing room.

Can I use earphones or headphones in the home TOEFL Test? + −

No. No equipment other than the desktop or the laptop are allowed. You will have to listen to the audio over the speakers. Ensure your speakers are functioning well and are clear.

Is dressing important in the take from home test? + −

Yes. Your photo will be shared with the institutions that receive your scores. Also, make sure you do not have any jewellry, clips, smartwatches etc, on you while you are taking the test.

Custom Training

Personalised, Online and Sectional Training at custom timings are avilable.

Talk to Us
"Since IELTS has gained wide acceptance in the US, most people today are taking the IELTS test in place of TOEFL."
Ben Spiel University Consultant

Regular Session Timings

9:00am – 10:00am
10:30am – 12:00 noon

Course Duration

2 days to 4 Weeks

Part 1 : Reading

3 – 5 passages; approximately 700 words long; 12 – 14 questions per passage.

Time: 60 – 80 mins
No of questions: 36 – 56
Score Scale: 0 – 30 points

Part 2 : Listening

4 – 6 lectures; each 3 – 5 minutes long; 6 questions each. 2 – 3 conversations; each 3 minutes long; 5 questions each.

Time: 60 – 90 minutes
No of questions: 34 – 51
Score Scale: 0 – 30 points

Part 3 : Speaking

2 tasks to express an opinion on a familiar topic; 4 tasks to speak based on what is read and listened to.

Time: 20 minutes
No of tasks: 6
Score Scale: 0 – 30 points

Part 4 : Writing

The task to write based on what is read and listened to; 1 task to support an opinion on a topic.

Time: 50 minutes
No of questions: 2
Score Scale: 0 – 30 points
